commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Collapse named contractions with user indexing maps (#25113)

A linalg.batch_matmul whose RHS indexing map drops the batch dim (the
usual `x @ W` with a leading batch) was never collapsed:
CollapseDimensions only considered linalg.generic, and
AnnotateDataTilingHints rejects the resulting two-M-dim contraction. The
same op written as a generic collapsed to a 2-D matmul and was
data-tiled, so data tiling depended on the named vs. generic form, and
on O2, where generalize-matmul hides the difference.

Make named contractions with projected-permutation maps eligible for
collapsing, in dispatch regions and in the standalone contraction
collapse pass, and generalize them before collapsing: upstream's
named-op collapse path clones the op with collapsed operands, which is
only valid when the collapse keeps the op's structure (e.g.
linalg.fill). Named contractions with their default maps have no
collapsible loops and are unaffected, and ones carrying a
compilation_info or lowering_config keep their loop space, as that
configuration refers to the original loops.

Fixes #25110.

usual `x @ W` with a leading batch) was never collapsed:
CollapseDimensions only considered linalg.generic, and
AnnotateDataTilingHints rejects the resulting two-M-dim contraction. The
same op written as a generic collapsed to a 2-D matmul and was
data-tiled, so data tiling depended on the named vs. generic form, and
on O2, where generalize-matmul hides the difference.

collapsing, in dispatch regions and in the standalone contraction
collapse pass, and generalize them before collapsing: upstream's
named-op collapse path clones the op with collapsed operands, which is
only valid when the collapse keeps the op's structure (e.g.
linalg.fill). Named contractions with their default maps have no
collapsible loops and are unaffected, and ones carrying a
compilation_info or lowering_config keep their loop space, as that
configuration refers to the original loops.

Fixes #25110.

commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Collapse named contractions with user indexing maps (#25113)

A linalg.batch_matmul whose RHS indexing map drops the batch dim (the
usual `x @ W` with a leading batch) was never collapsed:
CollapseDimensions only considered linalg.generic, and
AnnotateDataTilingHints rejects the resulting two-M-dim contraction. The
same op written as a generic collapsed to a 2-D matmul and was
data-tiled, so data tiling depended on the named vs. generic form, and
on O2, where generalize-matmul hides the difference.

Make named contractions with projected-permutation maps eligible for
collapsing, in dispatch regions and in the standalone contraction
collapse pass, and generalize them before collapsing: upstream's
named-op collapse path clones the op with collapsed operands, which is
only valid when the collapse keeps the op's structure (e.g.
linalg.fill). Named contractions with their default maps have no
collapsible loops and are unaffected, and ones carrying a
compilation_info or lowering_config keep their loop space, as that
configuration refers to the original loops.

Fixes #25110.
